issues.description: StockIngredient constructor signature differs between specification and template. The UML/problem statement specifies +StockIngredient(String, int, int), but the template provides StockIngredient(String, int, int, boolean strictValidation), which prevents students from instantiating StockIngredient exactly as specified (and as shown in Main) without changing the template API.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template to include the required constructor signature public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity). If validation modes are desired, keep them internal or add an overloaded constructor, but do not remove the required 3-argument constructor.

issues.description: The problem statement is internally inconsistent about whether SealSaloon.stock is an instance field or static. Part 1 first says SealSaloon has a final Stock stock initialized in the constructor (implying per-instance), but later explicitly requires the stock attribute to be static/shared across instances; the solution implements it as static final.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent by either (a) updating the UML/text to explicitly mark stock as static and removing wording that implies constructor initialization per instance, or (b) removing the static requirement if per-instance stock was intended.
